about: Words the project adds to the 16:9 patch's overlay (work/boot.widescreen.json), chosen by rt_widescreen like the patch's own. tools/recomp/psp_analyze.py merges them only when the patch is there, and stops if a word in the program is not the one listed as orig. Each has the decompiled code that does the same (src/core/...), so the reference run and the decomp agree with WIDE FORCED on.

text.why: 0x08810D84's left limit: subu t2,zero,a3 (minus the cell width) -> addiu t2,zero,-96, as the patch does in 0x08811BCC (0x08811E28), so a fighter's parts are drawn into the left margin
0x088117D0's left limit: subu t0,zero,a1 -> addiu t0,zero,-96, the same
